verdict.rationale: Motion publishes a first-party llms.txt at usemotion.com/llms.txt that an agent can be pointed at. It describes API access for managing projects and tasks plus product capabilities, and is backed by a docs site with a complete API reference. However, the llms.txt content shown is largely marketing- and industry-oriented rather than a structured index of developer docs. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt links to or indexes the API reference/docs (e.g., llms-full.txt or markdown docs), agent-specific documentation on docs.usemotion.com, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
